title: Min Stack
problemStatement: Design a stack that supports the following operations in constant time: push(x) pop() top() getMin() Initially, the stack is empty. Process a sequence of operations and print the result of every top() and getMin() query.
input: Integer q representing the number of operations. Next q lines each contain one operation.
output: For every top() and getMin() operation, print the corresponding result.
constraints: 1 <= q <= 10^5 All queried operations are valid.
